title: Whodunit in the Enigmatic Penthouse
story: In the lavish penthouse of a wealthy industrialist, Mr. R. K. Verma, a gruesome scene unfolds. The master bedroom door is locked from the inside, and the victim, Ms. Aisha Patel, a renowned art curator, lies lifeless on the floor. The room is cluttered with expensive art pieces, and the window is securely locked as well. The doorbell rings at 9 PM, unexpected guests discover the gruesome scene.
crimeScene: Enigmatic penthouse with valuable artworks and locked door
forensicClue: A torn painting invoice found near the body
question: Who committed the crime and how did they do it? Explain the solution.
options: Option A: Mr. Charles D'Souza (Suspect 1) - Bought a suspiciously similar painting the day prior.
Option B: Ms. Rachel Lee (Suspect 2) - Visited R. K. Verma prior to the crime, seeking a rare art piece.
Option C: Mr. Imtiaz Khan (Suspect 3) - Owns the torn painting invoice found near the body.
Option D: Miss Olivia Thompson (Suspect 4) - Showed peculiar behavior prior to the doorbell's ringing; had a grudge against Aisha for rejecting her promotion proposal
